svg.title: The 1949 armistice lines
svg.desc: Situation map covering 33.9°E to 36.5°E, 29.4°N to 33.5°N. Israel, the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, as they stood until June 1967. Areas of control in 4 classes: Israel (1949 armistice lines), West Bank, under Jordanian administration, Gaza Strip, under Egyptian administration, No man's land and demilitarised zones. Every zone is drawn as the record holds it, not assessed afresh: the lines of the 1949 armistice agreements; no claimed-only ground is shown. OpenHistoricalMap's relations for this region carry 'needs source' on their boundary lines, so the lines are as precise as a crowd-sourced record of them, no more. The UN General Assembly partition plan of November 1947 (resolution 181) is not drawn: no open vector of it exists, only the UN's scanned map 103.1(b). OpenHistoricalMap relations 2864015, 2744317, 2848316, 2855300, 2864013 (CC0); no man's land: OCHA oPt; Natural Earth basemap. As of the 1949 armistice agreements, to 5 June 1967. 4 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.
